description: OBD2 / CAN Adapter Hardware Profiles and Bus-Switching Commands

busSwitching.source: ELM Electronics ELM327 v1.4b / v2.1 Datasheet (https://www.elmelectronics.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/ELM327DS.pdf)
busSwitching.officialExcerpt: The ELM327 supports ISO 15765-4 CAN protocols via standard CAN pins. Standard chips have no internal multiplexer; connection to alternate CAN pins (e.g. Ford MS-CAN pins 3/11) requires external physical DPDT switching.
busSwitching.description: Standard ELM327 has a single CAN transceiver connected to OBD pins 6/14. MS-CAN (pins 3/11) access requires a physical DPDT switch or external cable adapter.

hsCan.prompt: Ensure adapter switch is set to HS-CAN (OBD pins 6/14)

msCan.prompt: Flip adapter switch to MS-CAN (OBD pins 3/11)

adapters.name: OBDLink (STN11xx / STN21xx / EX / MX / MX+ / LX / CX)

OBDLink LX.note: HS-CAN only. Lacks MS-CAN transceiver on pins 3/11.

OBDLink CX.note: HS-CAN only. Lacks MS-CAN transceiver on pins 3/11.

OBDLink SX.note: HS-CAN only. Lacks MS-CAN transceiver on pins 3/11.

busSwitching.source: OBDLink FRPM rev F, section 8.6 'Set Protocol (STP)', page 34
busSwitching.description: STN chips and OBDLink adapters with dual CAN transceivers (EX, MX, MX+, STN1170, STN2120) use STP 33 for HS-CAN and STP 53 for MS-CAN. Note: STP 31/51 are raw CAN presets (ISO 11898) without multi-frame ISO-TP reassembly, whereas STP 33/53 implement ISO 15765-4 with automatic multi-frame assembly.

busSwitching.source: UNVERIFIED: No official manufacturer documentation found in Vgate reference manuals or datasheets (https://www.vgatemall.com/downloadcenter). Commands ATHSCAN / ATMSCAN are undocumented community findings.
busSwitching.notes: unverified: ATHSCAN and ATMSCAN commands have no official published documentation from Vgate/OEM. Adapter will return '?' if firmware does not support them.
busSwitching.description: vLinker adapters implement electronic CAN transceiver routing. However, ATHSCAN and ATMSCAN lack official vendor documentation and are marked unverified.
